residual: Validator self-poisoning (harness issue, not a contract defect): the requested --json path C:\Workspaces\rag-platform\schemas\.validate-report.json lies inside the scanned schemas/ directory, so every run after the first ingests the previous report as a schema and emits 4 spurious ERRORs (file name not <kebab>.schema.json, not kebab-case, $schema missing, $id missing) plus 1 WARN/1 INFO. I deleted the stale report before the final run (errors=0); the final run wrote a fresh report at that path, so the orchestrator must `rm schemas/.validate-report.json` before re-running, write the report outside schemas/, or make the validator skip files not ending in .schema.json.
